items.proposed: no H3K27M selection row (drop A's eligibility row)
items.reason: The title states 'Regardless of Mutation Status' and inclusion requires 'Glioblastoma ... (including diffuse midline glioma, gliosarcoma or giant cell glioblastoma)'; H3 K27M appears only in a condition label and is not an entry requirement.
No eligibility or enrichment biomarker remains once the H3K27M row is dropped; CTCs by qRT-PCR are exploratory.

The brief summary says S-Gboxin is added 'to standard RT/TMZ treatment protocols', so radiotherapy is also partner antitumour therapy in the experimental arm. The arm label's 'during (or without) standard treatment' weakens this for some patients.

Inclusion requires 'confirmed diagnosis of Glioblastoma ... relapse or disease progression'; C10 codes progressive disease as recurrent. The summary's 'adding S-Gboxin to standard RT/TMZ' (a first-line regimen) conflicts, but the entry criterion defines who is enrolled.

note: The record is internally inconsistent on setting (relapse in eligibility vs added to first-line RT/TMZ in the summary). Temozolomide is listed by both coders as soc_backbone though it is not a registered intervention.
